## V5 audit completed; corrected paper available

**[Read the corrected v5 paper: v0.5.1, q < 2,000](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/releases/tag/v0.5.1)** ·
**[Download the corrected PDF](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/releases/download/v0.5.1/tenth-discriminant-v0.5.1.pdf)**

V5 has passed a **manual mathematical audit with exact computational
checks**. This is not formal verification. V0.5.1 applies the audit's
minor wording correction in §6.2: the decreasing upper bound is
`110.001 log(R)/R`. The certificate already used that bound, so
`q < 2,000` and all numerical results are unchanged.

[Audit finding and correction](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/blob/v0.5.1/versions/v5.1/AUDIT.md).
The earlier papers, tags, and downloadable assets remain unchanged.

---

The analytic cutoff improves to **`q < 4,000`**, a **250-fold improvement**
over v3.

**[Download the self-contained ten-page proof](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/releases/download/v0.4.0/tenth-discriminant-v0.4.0.pdf)** ·
**[Download the source and verification bundle](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/releases/download/v0.4.0/tenth-discriminant-v0.4.0.zip)**

The direct split-prime count from v3 is retained. Banks's quartic-field
determinant is replaced with Green's derivative determinant, with a
sharper nonsingularity criterion, a rectangle adapted to the quadratic
integer lattice, and tighter estimates for derivatives. The paper proves
the determinant and resultant arguments it uses and includes the
complete finite classification; earlier versions are not needed.

All **39 exact arithmetic checks** and **62,880 finite sanity cases** pass.
The uniform numerical contradiction has an exact rational gap greater
than `0.007`. A direct integer verifier checks all **499** remaining
candidates below 4,000 and confirms the same nine discriminants by
reduced-form enumeration.

**The v4 argument has passed independent mathematical verification,
confirmed on 20 October 2026. Both v3 papers have also passed independent
mathematical cross-checks.** The fixed paper, tag, and downloadable files
retain their status at publication; the current review record records
this subsequent verification.
The arithmetic and finite checks do not establish the general proof.
The stated Rosser–Schoenfeld estimates and classical quadratic theory
remain external inputs. No Heegner method or computed zero-free region
for quadratic Dirichlet L-functions is used.

All earlier papers, tags, and bundles remain unchanged. This is an
AI-assisted research draft, published as a prerelease for review.
